starter_files.contents:
# Interactive CLI Utility

Interactive CLI Utility is a draft CodeLeaf project.

## Required features
- [ ] Input validation
- [ ] Functions and reusable helpers
- [ ] A case-based menu
- [ ] Consistent output
- [ ] Clear error messages

Use synthetic data and a disposable directory. Do not commit credentials or personal data. Document setup, tests, supported Bash versions, limitations, and recovery. Bash snippets run locally or in a separately isolated runner; the CodeLeaf web process must not execute arbitrary learner Bash.

stretch_features: Add Bats behavioral tests and ShellCheck static analysis.
Add fixture data covering spaces, empty values, missing inputs, and command failures.
Document supported Bash and external utility versions and add a CI workflow.

tests.name: Functional behavior
criteria: Required behavior works on synthetic inputs.
Expected output and exit status are documented.

tests.name: Failure and recovery
criteria: Invalid inputs and failed dependencies are handled explicitly.
Side effects are limited to the configured practice directory and restore steps are documented.

tests.name: Security and operations
criteria: No secrets are embedded or logged.
Dry-run/preview is available for higher-impact changes.
Minimum version, tests, limitations, and rollback/recovery are documented.

notes: Derived from Bash.pdf Section D; all project source files and acceptance details are original CodeLeaf materials. This is a learning project, not production approval.
